name: Atharv Enterprises Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1990, Atharv Enterprises Ltd is a manufacturer of textile fabrics and synthetic 
fabrics.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
AEL is an exporter and manufacturer of fabrics, including:
a) PV FABRIC (Polyester Viscose)
b) Polyester fabric
c) PC fabric (Polyester Cotton)
d) Cotton fabric

pros: Stock is trading at 0.26 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 0.81% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 9,003 days.
Working capital days have increased from 7,062 days to 14,924 days
